cohort: The study included 405,936 women who had full-term vaginal births in Sweden between 2005 and 2015, comprising 52,367 cases with diagnosed PPH and 353,569 controls without PPH.
finding: Primiparity, increased maternal age (>35 years), obesity (BMI >30), and induction of labour were associated with an increased risk of postpartum haemorrhage, while grand multi-parity did not increase the risk.
mod_finding: The risk of postpartum haemorrhage was 55% higher when vaginal birth followed induction as compared to vaginal birth after spontaneous onset of labour.
